limitations: One learner seed per arm and a reused development evaluation panel; no repeatability or generalization claim.
Both rewards change together; this tests their combined effect, not their individual contributions.

Both actor and critic are freshly initialized with zero prior training. Architecture, action filtering and a frozen vocabulary originally fitted on training data are reused; their embedding weights are random.
On-policy trajectories and actual episode consumption may diverge despite matched reserved seed ranges.
Reward totals on different scales are not the primary comparison; Act 1 clears remain the target.
Headless evidence only; no new native-game validation.

Post-combat evaluation HP is a descriptive measurement of observed transitions from combat to a living non-combat public state. It excludes any instant fight without a projected combat state and does not isolate damage from automatic healing.
